resources.string: The following permissions are required before you can use SecuDash:
SecuDash needs access to app usage data in order to display the usage dashboard. Please enable \"Permit usage access\" for SecuDash on the next screen.
SecuDash uses an Accessibility Service to prevent the app from being silently uninstalled or its protections removed. Please enable \"SecuDash Protection\" on the next screen.
SecuDash must remain a Device Administrator to protect this device. Deactivation is blocked.
SecuDash requires Device Administrator rights to prevent unauthorised uninstallation and to keep the usage-monitoring service active at all times.
Monitors Settings screens to prevent removal of SecuDash protections (Device Admin and Accessibility Service). No personal data is read or transmitted.
No usage data available.\nMake sure App Usage Access is granted.
Monitoring app usage and device protection.
Keeps SecuDash running in the background to monitor app usage and maintain device protection.
